question: Can a limited culture-to-native-population RNA comparison guide selection of authenticated EMC experimental models for an independently justified transcriptional-state measurement beyond already published PDC/target-marker or fusion-partner comparisons?
source_field_selection: Existing all-model/library/donor/origin/condition/capture metadata, exact series-level/API processed declarations and same-normalization PDC comparator descriptions only. No gene/endpoint/matrix rows, read files, new raw matrices, hidden portal or login route. Coordinate owner zero-copy sources before requests.
critical_prior_value_gate: If no concrete useful model-selection consequence can be defended, no extra retrieval merely to show a computable similarity statistic. A population comparison does not universally require paired donor tissue.
prospective_review_fields: Specific selection/measurement consequence and primary prior-art difference
All authenticated native EMC cultures and native reference conditions, with ambiguous overlaps preserved
Actually public processed assay fields/normalization and same-capture disease culture controls
Exact series-level availability versus sample-level NONE, and public API limits
Culture/medium/passage, batch/capture, tissue mixture and lineage alternatives
Before-value assay/gene eligibility/statistic/control/uncertainty and defeat rules
numerical_stage: OFF. No outcomes/new genes mined; a useful exact prospective numerical question needs lead review.
exclusions: No TMEM266/DLK1/R8 panel rescue, prior donor-paired fidelity rebrand or denied structural-genomic/fusion-forming/topology/FAP/glycan/HLA scientific paper-body/sequence content. Exact library/condition identity labels may be reused.
preservation: Original empirical audit science5dc714... and all prior source freezes immutable; root alone shared Git/main/integration/push; Codex both identities.
